transcript.content: Hi, this is Sophia Silva. My confirmation number is H8Q05L. I want to cancel the travel insurance I bought for my flight and get a full refund, but I do not want to cancel the flight itself. I wasn't happy with the service I received, so I'd like the insurance refunded.
I'll look up your reservation to check the current details.

I found your reservation. However, I'm unable to remove or refund travel insurance after booking—that's outside our policy. Travel insurance is final once purchased as part of your booking.

What I can do is help you with other options if the service experience concerns you. If you'd like to discuss a service-related complaint or explore other solutions, I'm happy to help.
Okay, I understand. Thanks for checking anyway.
